scores.tell: None that matters. The smooth satin planet, clean ring and tone-on-tone stripe backdrop match the real cards. The crater highlight is slightly sharp.
Close to the graded wagon lesson. The spokes, cover folds and ground pebbles are a little crisp and dense, and the full landscape is busier than most real cards.
None that matters. The bevelled calculator floats over a pi pattern like the real floating-object cards. The edge glints are slightly plasticky.
The hero is small inside a wide grey moon landscape with craters and stars. The low-contrast grey-lavender key reads as a scene, not a close-framed object card.
The sleeping bag is slightly over-inflated into a puffy sausage, and the grass tufts add a busy foreground layer.
A storybook diorama: brick and shingle marks repeated across a leaning toy house, with trees, a hill and clouds. It is texture-heavy and painterly, unlike the smooth real objects.
The backpack is slightly chunky and evenly glossy. Otherwise its forms, colors and diamond backdrop fit the real cards.
A low camera angle with strong wide-angle convergence. The canopy and legs run off the card edges, and the hero is cropped instead of shown whole.
The hero is small and off-center, with blurry airbrushed light beams and a dense crisp truss lattice. It leaves a lot of empty gradient space.
Matches the real planet and towel staging. The fine sandy grain on the rock is slightly more textured than the real cards' smooth finish.
